email.description: An address, as git authors commits with it.
The address. Case and spaces around it do not count.

emailState.description: What claiming an address, or taking the claim back, did.

changed.description: Whether it changed anything: false for an address claimed already, or, taken back, never claimed.

count.description: How many addresses the account claims now.

main.description: Adds the address's hash to the dev.knotless.emails record of the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless account email add` does, so commits authored with it show as the account's on repositories it owns or pushes to. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account.

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

description: Claims an email address as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
